summary.en: Five broad dimensions of relatively stable tendencies, measured by questionnaire and compared with a norm group.
summary.ru: Пять широких измерений относительно устойчивых склонностей; измеряются опросником и сравниваются с нормативной группой.

variants.note: BFI-2 labels differ, e.g. Negative Emotionality, Open-Mindedness

constructs.description: How much the person tends to seek out new ideas, experiences and imagination.
How organised, dependable and persistent the person tends to be.
How much the person tends to seek company, speak up and draw energy from others.
How warm, trusting and cooperative the person tends to be with others.
How strongly the person tends to react to stress and setbacks with negative feelings.

mentalModel.summary: People differ in typical tendencies across situations; these are measured, not diagnosed.
assumptions: scores are relative to a norm group
situations shape how a tendency shows
mentalModel.unitOfAnalysis: the person's typical tendencies over years
mentalModel.howChangeHappens: Slowly, mostly across years; rank-order stability rises with age.
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Speak of tendencies and ranges, never of verdicts; never present a high or low score as a flaw.

do: show raw score, range and norm group together
ask where the score does not fit
dont: predict a single moment from a trait
use a score to explain away what the person says

exploratoryQuestions: Which of these tendencies do you recognise, and in which settings?
Where does the score not fit your experience?
helperMustNot: present a score as evidence of fit for a job or role
comment on facet Anxiety or Depression unless the person raises it
riskNotes: Facets named Anxiety and Depression read as health information

toolkit.name: Fit check
toolkit.description: Compare one domain with three recent episodes and note fit or no fit.

representations.description: Raw score, range and percentile with the norm group named.

suggestionRequires: the person asked for ways of describing tendencies

citations.note: Soto 2019: 87% of replication attempts significant in the expected direction
Roberts & DelVecchio 2000: rank-order consistency .31 in childhood to about .74 at ages 50-70

supports: choosing communication preferences the person then states
doesNotEstablish: what the person will do in a given moment
